rationale: The launch configuration does not set HttpTokens to required, so the instances it launches answer the metadata service over an unauthenticated GET, which a server-side request forgery in an application running on the instance is enough to reach. What comes back includes the temporary credentials of the instance profile. IMDSv2 requires a session token obtained through a PUT beforehand, which a forged request cannot perform. A launch configuration cannot be edited, so this will not be fixed in place: the group has to be moved to a launch template that requires IMDSv2.
remediation: Replace the launch configuration with a launch template whose metadata options require IMDSv2, point the Auto Scaling group at it and replace the running instances with an instance refresh
